headline: DFC backs WIOCC’s pan-African digital-infrastructure platform
summary: U.S. development-finance capital targets wholesale connectivity, data centres and metro fibre across 30 African countries.
why: Institutional capital is moving into the enabling layer for cloud, telecom and enterprise expansion—not a routine operator upgrade.

headline: Nigeria moves its $300m distributed-energy fund from structuring to deployment
summary: Commercial launch creates a dedicated capital platform for mini-grids, standalone solar and other distributed-energy assets.
why: The fund has crossed from a planned vehicle into active deployment—an important test of scalable private-capital mobilisation for energy access.

headline: Baleine Phase 3 moves decisively into delivery
summary: New offshore awards activate engineering, fabrication, installation, drilling and specialist-services demand.
why: The project has moved beyond development intent into a broader offshore delivery ecosystem.

headline: US$2.33bn financing changes the Tanzania SGR execution picture
summary: Capital formation opens a new delivery window across rail construction and corridor logistics.
why: The commercial test is conversion of financing into procurement, mobilisation and visible construction.

headline: Bishoftu enters the build phase—and begins activating talent
summary: Groundbreaking, financing work and specialist hiring provide evidence of movement.
why: The opportunity now depends on project preparation converting into contracted delivery packages.

headline: Project BRIDGE enters investor prequalification
summary: A major digital-infrastructure programme creates an opening across fibre, financing and delivery partnerships.
why: Prequalification begins separating credible capital and delivery partners from general market interest.

headline: Lobito’s next test is financed construction
summary: The corridor’s value now depends on converting capital commitments into coordinated delivery.
why: Cross-border infrastructure creates commercial value only when financing and execution align across the system.
